title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse on 1970-08-05
venue: Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse

ai_review.summary: Fair soundboard capture of a rare acoustic gospel set with uneven drum mix and an unusual setlist.
ai_review.review: The recording is an early‑70s acoustic show that sounds primitive – hissy, cloudy tape with a baffling right‑channel drum track that many reviewers call “horrible.” The performance itself is an oddball gospel‑flavored set that deviates from typical Dead concerts, which some listeners find intriguing while others are less impressed. Overall the audio quality limits enjoyment, but the rarity of the setlist gives it niche appeal.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is unusual and receives mixed praise; recording is average with noticeable technical flaws, leading to a middle‑range combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hissy, cloudy tape; right channel appears to have a completely different drum track; primitive era fidelity; some reviewers note the mix is uneven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic gospel‑oriented set that is not typical for the Dead, noted as uncommon and therefore of interest to collectors despite mixed performance impressions.

band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey's drumming described as horrible and mismatched between channels on the acoustic set.
